scope: 20 actual controlled dev failures only; not production coding-run evidence

parameters.trace_id_b64_sql_list: Exactly 20 distinct nonzero lowercase 32-hex IDs from actual receipt.traceIds; each rendered only as base64Encode(unhex('validated-id')). No example/fake IDs, placeholders, existing unrelated IDs or discovery query.
parameters.source_revision: Actual receipt.sourceRevision: exact 40-lowercase-hex main SHA; verify against the workflow run source.
parameters.window_start_utc: UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss: floor actual receipt.startedAt to a whole second.
parameters.window_end_utc: UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss: floor actual receipt.endedAt then add one second; exclusive. Keep fixed for every page and repeat.
parameters.row_offset: 0, 500, 1000, ... only if the previous full page has 500 rows; preserve every raw page until a page has fewer than 500 rows.

columnTypes.parent_span: 16 lowercase hex or empty exactly as returned for a native root; do not fabricate a zero parent
columnTypes.number: finite number; no default for null
columnTypes.time: UTC ISO timestamp with six fractional digits
columnTypes.bool: Accept the observed true/false or 1/0 encoding; retain raw spelling alongside typed value
columnTypes.label: bounded closed metadata, no arbitrary body; reject controls or delimiter injection
columnTypes.stage: bounded sanitized span/stage name, including spaces
columnTypes.causes: At most 256 characters of safeErrorAttributes name/code/detail chain; retain only its safe metadata, never message/stack
columnTypes.nullable: A ? suffix permits null; missing column is not null

span_counts.sql:
SELECT lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
  count() AS span_rows, uniqExact(uuid) AS span_row_uuids, uniqExact(span_id) AS span_ids,
  countIf(is_root_span) AS root_rows, countIf(status_code = 2) AS error_span_rows
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'dev'
  AND resource_attributes['service.version'] = '{{source_revision}}'
  AND trace_id IN ({{trace_id_b64_sql_list}})
GROUP BY trace_id_hex
ORDER BY trace_id_hex

span_rows.sql:
SELECT formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS started_utc,
  formatDateTime(end_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS ended_utc,
  toString(uuid) AS span_row_uuid, lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
  lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex, lower(hex(base64Decode(parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex,
  is_root_span, service_name AS service,
  coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) AS environment,
  nullIf(resource_attributes['service.version'], '') AS service_version,
  name AS stage, status_code, duration_nano / 1000000 AS duration_ms,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.route'], '') AS route,
  coalesce(nullIf(attributes['http.request.method'], ''), nullIf(attributes['http.method'], '')) AS method,
  coalesce(toFloatOrNull(attributes['http.response.status_code']), toFloatOrNull(attributes['http.status_code'])) AS http_status,
  coalesce(nullIf(attributes['db.system.name'], ''), nullIf(attributes['db.system'], '')) AS db_system,
  coalesce(nullIf(attributes['db.operation'], ''), nullIf(attributes['db.operation.name'], '')) AS db_operation,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.db.statement_id'], '') AS statement_id,
  toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.trace.sample_rate']) AS sample_rate,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.trace.retention'], '') AS retention,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.trace.critical'], '') AS critical_raw,
  nullIf(attributes['error.type'], '') AS error_type,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.code'], '') AS error_code,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.detail'], '') AS error_detail,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.causes'], '') AS error_causes
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'dev'
  AND resource_attributes['service.version'] = '{{source_revision}}'
  AND trace_id IN ({{trace_id_b64_sql_list}})
ORDER BY timestamp, trace_id, span_id, uuid
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

log_counts.sql:
SELECT lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
  count() AS log_rows, uniqExact(uuid) AS log_uuids, uniqExact(span_id) AS log_span_ids,
  countIf(severity_text = 'ERROR') AS error_log_rows,
  countIf(body NOT IN ('mikka.stage.completed', 'mikka.stage.failed')) AS unexpected_body_rows
FROM logs
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'dev'
  AND resource_attributes['service.version'] = '{{source_revision}}'
  AND trace_id IN ({{trace_id_b64_sql_list}})
GROUP BY trace_id_hex
ORDER BY trace_id_hex

log_rows.sql:
SELECT formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS emitted_utc,
  toString(uuid) AS log_uuid, lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
  lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex, service_name AS service,
  coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) AS environment,
  nullIf(resource_attributes['service.version'], '') AS service_version, severity_text,
  multiIf(body = 'mikka.stage.completed', 'completed', body = 'mikka.stage.failed', 'failed', 'unexpected_body_redacted') AS body_code,
  body IN ('mikka.stage.completed', 'mikka.stage.failed') AS safe_body_shape,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.stage'], '') AS stage,
  toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.trace.sample_rate']) AS sample_rate,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.trace.retention'], '') AS retention,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.trace.critical'], '') AS critical_raw,
  nullIf(attributes['error.type'], '') AS error_type,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.code'], '') AS error_code,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.detail'], '') AS error_detail,
  nullIf(attributes['mikka.error.causes'], '') AS error_causes
FROM logs
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
  AND service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'dev'
  AND resource_attributes['service.version'] = '{{source_revision}}'
  AND trace_id IN ({{trace_id_b64_sql_list}})
ORDER BY timestamp, trace_id, span_id, uuid
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

limits: Source/schema review only. These four dev-scoped SQL texts have not been compiled or executed against PostHog.
The pinned 14 production queries and their hash-bound normalizer/reconciler remain unchanged; the old normalizer will reject these new SQL names/texts.
Raw OTLP callback SUCCESS, SDK forceFlush success, HTTP 200 or MCP isError:false alone do not establish stored rows.
Do not query events/AI content, full attributes maps, SQL text, original error messages, prompts, output, tools, tokens or URLs.
A missing/error/truncated/unparseable response is not an empty complete table; null/missing rates remain unknown.
